Real Results from Biomimetic Dentistry

These stories represent what's possible when you choose a dentist committed to preserving your natural teeth:

Teeth Saved from Extraction

Patients like Derek S. have kept natural teeth that other dentists wanted to remove, avoiding the need for implants or partial dentures.

Root Canals Avoided

Through early intervention and biomimetic techniques, many patients have avoided root canal procedures and maintained healthy, living teeth.

Crown-Free Restorations

Instead of destructive crowns that eventually fail, patients receive seamless biomimetic restorations that preserve natural tooth structure.

Long-Term Oral Health

Patients with Dr. Noot for 10+ years maintain excellent oral health without the cycle of failed restorations common in traditional dentistry.
